listing.name: Gothic II: Night of the Raven (OpenGothic)
listing.summary: Play Gothic II: Night of the Raven with your own original files and OpenGothic. Upstream reports the main quest and expansion are completable. Gothic I and 32-bit Union plugins are unsupported. Desktop prerelease routes use Windows DirectX 12/Vulkan, Linux Vulkan or macOS Metal; check the selected package’s CPU requirements. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
listing.original_game_title: Gothic II: Night of the Raven

steps.title: Prepare the Night of the Raven runtime and data
steps.instruction: Use a complete permitted OpenGothic Windows copy and your own Gothic II: Night of the Raven data. Select native Gothic2Notr.exe with its matching resources/libraries. Gothic I, Gothic II Classic and existing 32-bit Union/AST/Ikarus plugins do not inherit compatibility from this route. Finish setup upstream rather than selecting an installer or a helper.

steps.title: Preserve the actual working directory as well as game data
steps.instruction: Retain the creating working directory and established literal -g argument pointing to the actual absolute Gothic II data root, if used. Automatic discovery is not a reason to change a working data selection.

steps.title: Check the working copy before registration
steps.instruction: Finish setup with the project’s tools, then start and quit the copy you intend to add. Keep its game executable, working folder and supported launch arguments. Review those details in Portcove and agree to launch them, then choose Play separately. Adding a copy does not confirm its game files or save compatibility.

steps.title: Keep updates and removal under the existing owner
steps.instruction: Close every running copy of the game before changing files. Keep the working game version and every data and profile folder recoverable. Update it with the project’s tools, then review and select the changed executable in Portcove before choosing Play. You manage setup, updates, file changes, data migration and recovery. Portcove monitors the process you selected; it does not prevent other copies from running or restrict the game’s file access. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. This route does not offer Portcove downloads, setup, updates, backups, rollback, data migration or external-file deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. Engine licensing does not grant rights to original game assets, music, mods or bundled components.
Before updating the game, keep a copy of its working files and every location containing saved data. Choosing a different executable does not give it a separate profile.
Preserve the complete creating working directory, actual original-data root, every save/config/mod and unknown file; do not assume the original vendor save directory contains all OpenGothic state.

references.title: OpenGothic settings and save locations
references.instruction: The selected Windows code uses working-directory Gothic.ini and log.txt, separately from original System/Gothic.ini, and writes save_slot_0.sav/save_slot_N.sav relative to the working directory. Preserve the complete creating working directory, actual original-data root, every save/config/mod and unknown file; do not assume the original vendor save directory contains all OpenGothic state.
